title: Evidence
intro: Upload files, record notes and links, link evidence to records and review it. Only verified evidence counts toward a gate.
registerIntro: A filename alone or an inaccessible link is never verified. A new file revision returns the item to Unverified.
fileCreateNote: Save the details first; you then upload the file.

field.title: Title
field.urlHint: The reviewer confirms whether the link is accessible.
field.fileNameHint: A reference only: it can never be verified.

itemNotVisible: Evidence item not visible to you
emptyBody: Add evidence for the diagnostic, baselines and design so the gates can be verified.

upload.title: Upload a file: {{title}}
upload.description: The file is stored as a new revision with its checksum. The item becomes Unverified until it is reviewed again.

review.label: Verification
review.title: Review evidence: {{title}}
review.description: Verify the evidence only if you could open and check its content. State whether it is accessible.
review.notOwn: Created by you: another reviewer verifies it.
review.filenameNeverVerified: A filename reference can never be verified; attach the file or a note instead.

links.title: Evidence links
links.intro: Which record each evidence item supports.
links.description: Linking needs edit rights on the target record.
links.removeDescription: The link is kept in the history with your reason.
links.note: Removing a link keeps it in the history; the evidence item itself is not changed.
